description: Set the weekdays the household preps ahead for the week, and the hour it starts. Steps a recipe allows to be done early are then shown on the latest prep day that keeps them fresh. An empty weekdays list turns prep days off. freezesPrep lets steps that keep frozen go to an earlier prep day.

freezesPrep.description: True when the household freezes what keeps frozen, so it can be made on an earlier prep day. Omit to leave it as it is.

time.description: When prep starts on those days, 24-hour HH:mm. Omit to keep the hour the household has (15:00 when it has none).

weekdays.description: The prep days. Empty turns prep days off.

name: set_prep_days
title: Set prep days
